page.notes: Printed text is in the 16th–17th century Latin style; the faint mirrored (show-through) text from the other side of the leaf was left out. "Ibid." and the bracketed-style references are italic in the print. "Commentar" is set with a decorative initial that I could not read with certainty and is copied as "Commentar" [?]. The argumentarionibus spelling is as printed. Hyphens at line ends are kept where the print hyphenates (va-ticiniis, Lamentatio-num, nu-).
